origin.description: Convert a time in seconds into the ~HHh MMm SSs text printed by timerProgressBar.

arguments.name: time
arguments.text: Numeric of length 1, time in seconds. NULL returns calculating.

origin.details: Seconds are round(time %% 60) and are not carried when that rounds to 60. Days, hours, and minutes are shown once any larger unit is positive, including a zero hour on a positive day. Both infinities are Inf. A length other than 1 is an error.
origin.value: Time in ~HHh MMm SSs format as character. calculating when time is NULL.

translation.description: Format one time in seconds as days, hours, minutes, and seconds.

arguments.name: time
arguments.text: One number, or a list of one number. None is NULL and returns calculating.

translation.details: Seconds use R's round of the remainder and stay at 60 instead of becoming the next minute. A negative time follows R's %%. inf and -inf are Inf. A missing number raises ValueError.
translation.value: A string such as 01h 40m 05s, or calculating.
translation.example:
from pbapply.time import getTimeAsString

print(getTimeAsString(None))
print(getTimeAsString(15))
print(getTimeAsString(65))
print(getTimeAsString(6005))
